title: Safe sanitation summary (real CC-BY prose from Our World in Data)

source.attribution: Our World in Data (Ritchie, Spooner, Roser), CC-BY-4.0
source.notes: Composed from real Our World in Data figures (CC-BY): just over half use safely managed sanitation, nearly one in two do not; in the lowest-income countries only about one in five use it. Clean version verified internally consistent (just over half ~ 50%; one in five use -> four in five without) before injecting 3 defects findable from the text's own numbers.
